purpose: Controlled diagnosis of the completed seed-42 four-bar run; no baseline replacement

physical_oracle.note: Oracle controls use evaluator-only states and physics parameters. Learned acceleration at true keypoints is an out-of-domain probe if the semantic check fails.

statistics: Per-sequence paired bootstrap, 2000 draws, seed 20261010; 95% percentile interval. One training seed only.
interpretation: A benefit from framewise reconstruction supports an accumulation/dynamics bottleneck relative to the autoencoder, but does not prove accurate physical state recognition.
Agreement of converged inference solvers rules against inference integration as the main bottleneck of this checkpoint.
Physical-oracle solver and initial-velocity interventions isolate numerical and sampling effects in a known-correct dynamics system.
No closed-chain-specific causal conclusion without a matched topology control; no training-integrator causal conclusion without retraining.
